name: mdblist-hub-apk
description: Empacotamento Android do mdblist hub: wrapper Capacitor (android/) e app nativo nao-WebView (android-native/). O site em si vive no repo irmao ../mdblist-hub.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build --prefix ../mdblist-hub && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleMobileDebug assembleTvDebug
scripts.android:apk:mobile: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleMobileDebug
scripts.android:apk:tv: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleTvDebug
